message.content:
The idea of a single “best” film is highly subjective and depends on what you’re looking for—critical acclaim, box‑office success, awards, or personal taste. Below are a few 2020 releases that were widely praised by critics and/or received major awards, which often serve as a benchmark for what many consider the best films of that year. | Film | Genre | Notable Accolades / Ratings | |------|-------|-----------------------------| | **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | Drama / Political Thriller | • 2020 Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay
• 2020 Golden Globe for Best Motion Picture – Drama
• Rotten Tomatoes: 95 % fresh | | **Soul** | Animated / Fantasy | • 2020 Academy Award for Best Animated Feature
• 2020 Golden Globe for Best Animated Feature Film
• Rotten Tomatoes: 98 % fresh | | **The Father** | Drama | • 2020 Academy Award for Best Actor (Anthony Hopkins)
• 2020 Golden Globe for Best Actor – Drama
• Rotten Tomatoes: 94 % fresh | | **Tenet** | Action / Sci‑Fi | • 2020 Academy Award nomination for Best Visual Effects
• Rotten Tomatoes: 70 % fresh | | **The Invisible Man** | Horror / Thriller | • 2020 Academy Award nomination for Best Visual Effects
• Rotten Tomatoes: 91 % fresh | ### How to decide which one is “best” for you 1. **Genre preference** – If you enjoy animated storytelling, *Soul* is a standout. 2. **Critical consensus** – *The Trial of the Chicago 7* and *Soul* both have the highest Rotten Tomatoes scores among 2020 releases. 3. **Award recognition** – *The Trial of the Chicago 7* won the most prestigious awards for a 2020 film (Best Original Screenplay). 4. **Personal impact** – Some viewers find *The Father* emotionally resonant, while others prefer the mind‑bending narrative of *Tenet*. Feel free to pick the one that aligns with your interests, or watch a few of them to see which resonates most with you!
